local_policies: Six actual past sources plus the exact VAC_413t dbf113343 child; primary Gilly full responses name childIds113343 and presskit names the actual token. No token is inferred from an ID prefix. Raw AFK omitted ATK is preserved as None; two full primary faces explicitly report0, so only this exact missing-zero field normalizes to0.

End bodies use existing EndTurnSpec scopes (Kel either, all others controller), accepted/repeated/extra end bodies stay in the common scheduler. Turn-start Maw uses actual own turn event. No parallel end-phase scheduler or synthetic public event is added.

Kel queries all actual friendly board DeathRecords in this global turn at the actual body execution, each occurrence distinct, original death order; passes the frozen complete death_ids to ordinary attributed base Resurrect. Later new reactive deaths are not inserted into this already accepted batch. Quantity, capacity, waiting and original resurrection material remain shared. Exact simultaneous/current CN order deferred.

Hamm chooses uniformly from current physical enemy DECK minions only. Empty inventory consumes no RNG. Existing DestroyStoredCard handles actual removal and only then rewards the original living source2/2; no fake board death, Deathrattle, discard or Corpse. Original reference invalidation skips reward; exact CN reveal/window boundaries deferred.

Gilly adds the exact2mana2/3 Hunter Beast VAC_413t via normal hand entry/burn. Actual DR captures current controller original hand MINION references and gives each2/3; source need not survive. Original deck construction Tourist profiles are unchanged: generating or playing a Tourist is not an original-main-deck permission grant, and no independent Wild deckbuilding pool is introduced.

AFK at actual body execution reads current other friendly active alive minions, original continuous board presence, and this global-turn completed combat facts, including forced combat. Canceled attacks without combat do not count under recorded local policy. Manual attack-use counters are not substituted; a new board residence resets eligibility while same residence across control/face retains combat facts. Selected recipients do not include later new summons.

Maw own end gains5Corpses. Own start first gates original living source, then uses existing all-or-none SpendResource5 and GainMaxHealth5 preserving missing Health. Below5 spends nothing, accepted payment reward survives subsequent source removal. No new Corpse or hero-health account.

Lothar composes the existing random-enemy-minion selector and existing force_attack acceptance, then captures the actually created CharacterAttackRecord window ID. The typed continuation binds that forced source/card/controller/epoch/order and causal combat/poison fatal transition of the final delivered target; normal attacks and unrelated forced attacks never install this reward. Surviving original source grows3/3 only if that combat killed a minion. Canceled/empty/nonlethal/source gone skip. Existing combat redirects/secrets/shields/deaths own execution; exact redirected-victim and timing CN edges remain local policy.

All732 past identities and the original pool roles/order/weights are preserved. New definition presence is not full past pool binding or formal qualification. MIS_701 remains evidence-only; version/hotfix/CN boundary work remains deferred.
